TC-21/S19.detail:
This is a fail. One failing point is decided now and is not in the matrix, and one recorded gap applies.

(a) Templates offered. The prompt library has 12 templates. The app shows only a fixed list for each context (apps/web/src/lib/templates.ts):
- Hospital: hp, soap, consult, discharge.
- SNF: snf-admission, snf-progress.

No SNF Consult or SNF Discharge template exists. The status mapping points a Consult to "snf-consult", which isn't offered, so it falls back to snf-progress. This is the recorded gap known:no-snf-consult-discharge-templates (TFA-92599 AC 2).

(b) Retention windows and the purge.
- **Windows:** they are `as const` source constants, HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. They are not environment or database configuration. Whether that counts as the "configuration value" 3.6 asks for is the reviewer's call (pending:signoff).
- **Clock:** both lifecycle mutations take the time from Date.now() on the Convex server, so the clock is server time.
- **Purge (new failing point):** there is no lifecycle or purge cron. convex/crons.ts registers only the hourly session sweep. The purge runs only when the client calls rounding.applyLifecycle or snf.applyLifecycle: from AppLayout's ContextLifecycle when a page opens, then every 10 minutes while it stays open. So the purge code runs on the server, but nothing on the server starts it. If no client opens the app, expired PHI stays stored.

The person's side-by-side of the 6 surviving templates against p72 was not judged here.
TC-21/S19.detailRun2: (a) The prompt library has 12 templates. The hospital picker offers only H&P, SOAP, Consult and Discharge (HOSPITAL_TEMPLATE_IDS), and the SNF picker offers only SNF Admission and SNF Follow-up (SNF_TEMPLATE_IDS). There is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge file. The status map points SNF "consult" at the id "snf-consult", which is not in the SNF list, so it falls back to snf-progress. This is the recorded gap known:no-snf-consult-discharge-templates (TFA-92599 AC 2). (b) The retention windows are `as const` objects (HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION) in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts. They are source constants, not runtime configuration. Whether that counts as the "configuration value" 3.6 asks for is the reviewer's call (pending:signoff). The clocks are server time: both applyLifecycle mutations use Date.now() on the Convex server. But nothing purges on a server schedule. convex/crons.ts registers only the session sweep. The purge runs only when the client calls it: ContextLifecycle in AppLayout.tsx calls rounding/snf.applyLifecycle on mount and then every 10 minutes with window.setInterval. If no physician opens the app, expired PHI is never purged. That gap is not in the matrix and waits on no question, so the verdict is fail.
TC-21/S19.physicianImpact: A nursing-home physician cannot pick an SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note format; a consult resident gets the SNF progress template by default. Expired working data such as transcripts, notes and medications is cleared only when the physician opens the app. If nobody logs in, it stays stored past its retention window. / Expired patient working data (pre-round notes, transcripts, notes, done tasks) is cleared only while that physician has the app open. If they stop logging in, PHI stays past the 12–48h windows. In the nursing-home context there is no SNF Consult or SNF Discharge note, and a consult status quietly pre-selects SNF Follow-up instead.
